caption: The video captures a fixed, wide surveillance-style view of a residential area lit by low, bright sun, with a long pale-yellow apartment block on the left, a taller red-and-white block on the right, and a row of bare and reddish trees between them. A grassy dirt clearing with footpaths, two rusty utility poles and a small mound fills the foreground, while a blue pedestrian sign marks the curving road at the left. A white car parked before the building and a dark car at the far-right edge remain motionless, confirming the camera does not pan, tilt or zoom. Within this excerpt, traffic and pedestrians cross in brief, unrelated transits. A white coach passes along the right-hand road. It is followed later by a white van and a light car moving through the same strip. On the left intersection, a white van, a dark sedan and a silver car appear one after another, and a yellow wheeled loader enters at the far-left edge. Small figures walk across the central clearing, along the left sidewalk near the sign, and on the right footpath. These are separate, brief transits rather than one continuous walk.
